concept: Respecting skilled trades and hands-on work as equal in value to academic paths
source_inspiration: original content, informed by Odyssey's explicit builders-matter-as-much-as-thinkers principle — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student encounters a scenario where a skilled tradesperson's expertise solves a problem an academic approach couldn't
exercise.branching_choice: Student reflects on what specialized craft knowledge actually requires
exercise.practice: Student identifies a trade or craft skill they respect and one thing that makes it genuinely difficult to master

assessment.success_marker: student names something specific and real about the skill's difficulty, not a generic statement of respect
